subject: Targeting the Primate Engine: How Low-Dose Rapamycin Resets Cerebral Microcirculation in Presymptomatic APOE4 Carriers
script: From Agewell Brief: Targeting the Primate Engine: How Low-Dose Rapamycin Resets Cerebral Microcirculation in Presymptomatic APOE4 Carriers. A new pilot single-arm trial reveals that four weeks of low-dose rapamycin selectively restores brain blood flow in healthy middle-aged adults carrying the high-risk APOE4 gene variant, pointing toward an early biophysical defense against cognitive decline. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
